name: Kolda
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and French first-party discovery identified DGID/CSF Kolda as the local cadastral custodian and Géo Sénégal/ONDDL SIG as public geospatial sources. The ONDDL public WFS was followed through current GetCapabilities and a bounded Kolda-area administrative request. It exposed no parcel layer or safe parcel ID+geometry response; no sample GeoJSON was retained.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: official DGID custodian and CSF Kolda directory evidence
official NICAD procedure; territorial Bureau du Cadastre handles cadastral identification and plan extracts
official ANAT topographic KML/SHP page; no parcel layer
nine administrative datasets; no parcel/cadastre dataset
public WFS schema/capabilities; EPSG:4326 administrative layers only
bounded department MultiPolygon response, not a parcel

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [12.8934851754938, -14.9369263744723] preserved in latitude/longitude order; never shifted.
Administrative WFS geometry and an empty public parcel discovery are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Local DGID custodian evidence does not demonstrate public parcel geometry, complete city coverage, currentness or legal title coverage.
No retained GeoJSON sample exists because no unchanged native parcel geometry and stable native ID were obtained anonymously.

alsoObserved: ONDDL administrative response fields id/name/geom; not parcel fields and not retained
nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created.

uncertainty: DGID's official sources establish a local Kolda cadastral custodian and public procedures. Public ONDDL/Géo Sénégal sources inspected here provide administrative/topographic data, not anonymous cadastral parcel features. No credentials, unsafe fields, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception or source integration/admission was used.
